cells.gaps: No fact shows any station entering a report or a case digitally: the 2024 statement is that the occurrence book, crime register and dockets are paper at headquarters and across the service (ZMB-007, ZMB-009), which disagrees with the same study's headquarters Police Information Management System holding crime reports and case files (ZMB-010), and nothing says who enters those. The centralised system the 40 stations are to be connected to is not implemented and no station count or pilot is given; finance is not stated for it, the 2024 domestic allocation (ZMB-013) being for e-Government at headquarters as a whole.
cells.note: Rung 2 on a records system at headquarters only and a station system in preparation, with networking equipment received for 40 stations by February 2026. Not rung 3 because nothing is live in any station outside the capital; the Electronic Occurrence Book of 2021 is confined to the Victim Support Unit and sets nothing, and ZMB-001 to ZMB-004 are from the excluded source.
